why_it_moved.text: The scorecard has no segment cuts, so the mechanism is unknown; the hypothesis is that the new ranker lifts the share of searches ending in a successful click.
why_it_moved.label: guess

why_it_moved.text: Click-based secondaries (CTR, Long Click Rate) did not rise with the primary.
why_it_moved.label: measured

would_change: A pre-exposure comparison showing the arms already differed on Successful Search Rate would make the call Can't tell.
A daily series by days since first exposure showing the lift fading would move the call to Keep running.
